items.name: agent-queue
items.title: Agent Queue
items.description: An agent work queue: one lane per agent with the run in progress, what comes next and why it waits, and what waits for a person. Use it for an agents overview page. Presentational: map runs from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/runs and issues from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues to AgentQueueData.
items.docs: Purely presentational: pass AgentQueueData (lanes built from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents runs and @nocobase/app-plugin-projects issues), the viewer, issueHref and onNavigate, and labels from your locale resources (English by default).

items.name: agent-run-history
items.title: Agent Run History
items.description: An agent's runs on one subject: a compact side-column log with a live timer, an all-runs dialog, the live pill, an activity row, a run's transcript and its brief. Use it beside a record agents work on. Presentational: map SubjectRun and Run from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents to AgentRunHistoryRun.
items.docs: Map your runs to AgentRunHistoryRun (newest first) and their events to RunTranscriptEvent; runHref and onOpenRun open a run, onStop and onRetry report actions for you to confirm and perform. Every word comes from the labels props, English by default. Pass complete events to RunTranscript; scope preferenceKey by application and user, and translate filterLabels.

items.name: agent-composer
items.title: Agent Composer
items.description: The message box for talking to an agent: page-context chips inside it (each can open a preview of what it carries), files to send (attach, paste, drop, uploaded before sending), Enter to send, Stop while the agent works, and a toolbar slot for a picker such as the agent's. Use it wherever a person writes to an agent. Presentational: context chips, drafts and focus come from the agents plugin's chat hooks (@nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat) through optional props.
items.docs: Pass onSend (return true, or a promise of true, once the message is taken), and optionally running, onStop, toolbar and notice; pass attachments (upload, and optionally discard and registerAdd; useChatAttachments of @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat uploads to the plugin) to send files; wire context (chips from contextChips and buildPageContext of @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat, and optionally inspect, which makes each chip open a preview of what it carries), draft and registerFocus from the chat panel when it sits in one. Every word comes from the labels prop, English by default.

items.name: agent-picker
items.title: Agent Picker
items.description: The one way to pick an agent: a trigger with the agent's avatar (availability dot on its corner) and name, and a menu of every enabled agent with what it is good at, its default and "personal runners only" tags, and why one cannot answer the viewer now (it cannot be picked then). Two appearances: field, which looks like a form's select, for forms and settings; toolbar, compact, for a composer. Presentational: pass ChatAgent records from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/shared/conversations.
items.docs: Pass the agents (useChatAgents from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat for chat, or useAgentOptions().agents from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/kit for a form), value and onSelect. appearance is field by default (noneOption offers no agent, placeholder, disabled, id for a label); appearance='toolbar' fits a composer, and bound marks an existing conversation, whose agent cannot change. Also exports AgentIdentity (avatar, dot and name as one row, for a picker that lists agents among people), AvailabilityDot, AgentTags and AgentTag. Every word comes from the labels prop, English by default.

items.name: agent-chat
items.title: Agent Chat
items.description: A simple agent conversation panel with shared page/panel headers, history, composer and launchers. It has no association requirements. For related-work slots and conversation details, add agent-chat-details.
items.docs: Requires the agents plugin (and the file plugin on the server for files sent in chat): wrap the routes in ChatProvider from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat (pass memoryScope, the signed-in person's id, so a new conversation starts with the agent they used last; pass conversationPath when ChatConversationPage has a route such as /chat/:conversationId), optionally with ChatExtensionsContext for cards among the messages. Render ChatPanel as a sibling of <main> inside a `relative flex` row, ChatHeaderButton in the header and ChatFloatingButton anywhere; add the plugin's chatLinkRoutes(base) for links that open the panel; spread locales/ into client/locales/.

items.name: agent-chat-details
items.title: Agent Chat with Details
items.description: The agent chat workspace: the conversation list, one conversation and its details (linked work such as tasks, context usage, runtime and agent), laid out by its own width as one column, list beside conversation, or list, conversation and details. Mount it as a full page with the selection in the address, or in the side panel with LinkedChatPanel; both are the same component. Linked work uses generic ConversationLink sections; applications add their own through narrow slots. No task or project dependency.
items.docs: Mount ChatWorkspace on a page (selection in the address) and LinkedChatPanel under the same ChatProvider as the simple ChatPanel (selection in the panel store); both are the same workspace. Add application-specific parts through narrow slots: list.heading, list.row (extra, facts, status), list.filters/filter, renderBody, metadata, detailsMetadata and scope; slots[kind] renders a related-work section and renderSummary the summary row. Passive details reuse cached conversation and usage snapshots; no polling is added.
